skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate and edit AI images through the RunComfy CLI. The skill selects suitable text-to-image and image-to-image routes across FLUX, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Qwen, Wan, and related models.
skill.summary: Route image generation and editing requests to RunComfy model endpoints.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation links, placeholder URLs, and model-selection wording. The real risks are intended RunComfy CLI execution, remote processing of prompts and reference images, and npm/npx setup guidance. No prompt-injection attempt was found in the skill text.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and remote processing
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before running RunComfy or sending prompts, image URLs, or web-search grounded requests.
Keep npm and npx commands as manual setup steps, and keep executable skill scope limited to runcomfy commands.
Use only user-provided reference URLs, keep web search off by default, and document that remote content is untrusted.

content.value_statement: Choosing the right image model is hard when each endpoint has different strengths. This skill routes Claude, Codex, or Claude Code requests to suitable RunComfy image workflows.
actual_capabilities: Selects RunComfy text-to-image routes for product images, posters, portraits, and concept art.
Selects image-to-image edit routes for reference images, layout changes, and identity-preserving variants.
Provides documented prompt patterns for FLUX, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Qwen, Wan, and related models.
Builds minimal RunComfy CLI invocations with model IDs, input fields, and output folders.
Explains model tradeoffs for typography, photorealism, speed, open weights, and multi-reference work.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Sends prompts and reference image URLs to RunComfy for remote processing.
Does not provide mask-driven inpainting or advanced batch editing in this skill.
Model availability, pricing, and schemas can change outside the skill.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate posters, hero images, and multilingual creatives with model guidance for text accuracy and layout control.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Produce fast moodboards, product shots, and style variants before selecting a final image route.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Use consistent RunComfy CLI patterns for repeatable generation and edit tasks in agent workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a square image of [subject]. Use [style] and [lighting]. Choose the best RunComfy model and save the result locally.

prompt_templates.title: Create Text in an Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Poster or advertisement with exact wording
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a landscape poster for [brand]. The headline must read exactly "[text]". Pick a model that handles typography well.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this reference image: [URL]. Keep [protected elements] unchanged. Change only [requested change] and explain the selected route.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Model Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an image workflow for [project]. Compare speed, text accuracy, photorealism, and open-weight needs. Then generate the first production image.

output_examples.input: Create a product photo of a ceramic mug on a marble counter.
output_examples.output: The skill selects a fast product-image route and produces a warm, clean product composition in the output folder.

output_examples.input: Make a poster with the exact headline AURORA Spring 2026.
output_examples.output: The skill chooses a typography-focused route and returns a poster image with the requested headline and layout.

output_examples.input: Use this portrait URL and change only the background.
output_examples.output: The skill selects an image-edit route and preserves the subject while generating the requested new background.

best_practices: State the subject, style, lighting, size, and any exact text before asking for generation.
Use user-provided reference URLs only, and describe what each reference should control.
Keep web search disabled unless real-world grounding is required and explicitly requested.
anti_patterns: Do not send private images, secrets, or confidential text unless the user accepts remote processing.
Do not request arbitrary image sizes for models that publish fixed size choices.
Do not use this skill for mask-driven inpainting when a dedicated edit skill is required.

faq.question: What does this skill use to create images?
faq.answer: It uses the RunComfy CLI to call hosted image generation and edit models.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports image-to-image routes when the user provides reference image URLs.

faq.question: Can it create images with exact text?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends typography-focused routes for posters, labels, and multilingual text.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: RunComfy downloads generated results into the chosen local output directory.

faq.question: What should users avoid sharing?
faq.answer: Users should avoid confidential prompts, private image URLs, credentials, and regulated data.
